Package com.sa.gms.restclient.chromadb.core

Class ChromaClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.sa.gms.restclient.chromadb.core.ChromaClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IChromaClient
@Component public class ChromaClientImpl extends Object implements IChromaClient
Implementation of IChromaClient using IRestClient. Provides methods for interacting with Chroma DB API.
